blocks.text: Directive Principles guide the state when it makes laws and policies. They express social and economic goals for governance and are intended to be applied by legislatures and governments.

items: Adequate means of livelihood and fair working conditions.
Protection of the environment and public health.
Promotion of international peace and security.

blocks.title: How they relate to rights
blocks.text: Fundamental Rights are enforceable in court. Directive Principles are not directly enforceable, but they guide lawmaking and governance.
